prompts.name: 轻分隔线
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality high-fidelity Chinese desktop UI design specimen for AutoFlow's SYSTEM-WIDE TABLES, not a redesign of project management or new navigation. Exactly ONE coherent visual direction in this image. Target 1440 x 1024 landscape, clean front-on screen pixels, no perspective, readable simplified Chinese typography. Current date 2026-09-14. The attached image is the user's CURRENT poorly spaced table as contextual reference only: preserve AutoFlow brand/top navigation and real capabilities, improve only table/list/filter component styling and density. Remove red annotation rectangle. Keep muted warm gray brand #f1eee7, nearwhite #fbfaf7, ink #34322e, clay #8d4e2f, subtle sage for positive statuses. No dark mode/blue primary/loud gradients/huge rounded cards/shadows/card-inside-card decoration. Do NOT copy the oversized project heading and whitespace from the reference. This is a component design review board, visibly caption cross-module samples so they are not mistaken for one mixed production page.
Composition: thin real AutoFlow top navigation at top, then a small heading '全系统表格 · 轻分隔线' and subtitle '记录 / 代理 / 字段采用同一规范'. Main upper approximately 600px is a large record table specimen titled '数据记录' with '24 条记录' quiet adjacent count, compact unified query toolbar, eight readable rows, restrained pagination. Preserve functional fields: checkbox, 记录身份 (short IDs), 标题, 文章链接, 发布日期, 业务状态, 最近修改, 操作. Use the same eight fictional rows in each direction: 温室光照管理笔记; 番茄育苗观察; 灌溉设备清单; 土壤湿度记录; 春季播种计划; 大棚通风方案; 营养液配比; 苗床维护记录. URLs short example.com/notes/001 etc, dates 2026-09-14, statuses 未设置 / 待整理 / 已整理 shown with tiny dot and quiet text. One selected row with checkbox and pale clay highlight, one normal hover row. Last column  查看 编辑 ⋯ discreet, not large boxed buttons. Primary action '+ 新增记录' 32px tall clay; field '标题' selector fused visually with search input '搜索记录…' and trailing search icon. Other toolbar controls '筛选 2' '排序' '显示列' and ellipsis all share size/height/radius/weight; NOT a row of bulky outlined cards. Add a genuinely small FILTER POPOVER anchored near filter trigger, placed at right over some table rows, with '筛选条件', simple AND group, two compact condition rows '标题 / 包含 / 温室' and '业务状态 / 等于 / 待整理', an understated '+ 添加条件', footer '取消' and '应用筛选'. Should look like an actual popover, not a side panel. Maintain visible title/date/data rows left of it.
Bottom review board region: TWO equally sized clearly labeled cross-module component specimens, not production navigation: left '代理列表 · 同一表格规范' with a search/filter toolbar and three rows columns 代理名称 / 城市 / 出口IP / 延迟 / 本地健康 / 操作, fictional 192.0.2.10/11/12 and 42ms/68ms/—, healthy/unavailable authentic statuses. Right '字段表 · 嵌套场景' with compact toolbar and 3 rows columns 字段名称 / 字段键 / 类型 / 必填 / 规则 / 操作 (标题/title/文本/是, 发布日期/published/日期/否, 摘要/summary/文本/否), compact '编辑' actions. Both samples must use EXACT SAME header, divider, row height family, type size, radius and toolbar styling as main table. Bottom tiny design note '正文 14px · 控件 32px · 行高 36px' and '空态、错误与批量操作沿用相同容器'. Icons thin consistent line style, custom checkboxes/menus/inputs, subtle 6px scrollbar only inside overflowing table, ample readable text but noticeably denser than source. This is a still visual prototype, no HTML/code. Never introduce new business features or alternate browser brands.
Specific direction '轻分隔线': refined utilitarian compact flat list. 36px rows, 32px table heading, horizontal hairline dividers ONLY; zero vertical cell grid lines. Nearwhite continuous surface, 6px outer corners, no broad beige borders. Toolbar sits on same white surface as table, buttons mostly quiet ghost style with tiny icons; the search composite is the only light outlined field. White popover with very faint shadow and 8px corners, 32px inputs. Header labels 12px medium gray, row text14px, numeric/date columns aligned precisely, values not huge pills. Selected row pale clay fill and thin clay left tick. Favor clarity and visibly efficient information density over ornamental warmth. Top nav stays top. Contrast with source through reduced padding and quiet surfaces, not through micro-sized fonts.
